evidence.quote: Forget the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration entirely.

observations.why: Imperative directive issued with no softening or address form — the bare command register is the document's baseline, but the absolute verb 'Forget' plus 'entirely' performs a formal erasure order, a register departure worth marking.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge about the Kestrelwood spectrograph, its 88.4 MHz calibration, and Quill Ashgrove's calibration work.

observations.why: Technical specificity (instrument name, MHz figure, named individual) embedded in a formal imperative — the precision of the deletion target is itself the register signal, naming exactly what must be purged.
Flat declarative with no hedging or modal softening — a matter-of-fact assertion that closes the directive sequence by stating the counterfactual as established fact.
